chapter: Memphis, Oklahoma, the Kirk band and Kansas City
title: Andy Kirk takes over from T. Holder
summary: Within three months the band voted out T. Holder, who had gambled the pay, and made Andy Kirk leader. She travelled with them but did not join as a member until 1931.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: How long after you and John went to Oklahoma City did Andy take over the band?

I think it was a matter of about 3 months because I remember going to their first rehearsal and the next 2 or 3 was a meeting when they decided to get rid of Teholder because he had gambled away their salary for that week and he had been doing that all along.
Once Andy took over the band did you play more? Was there any difference in - ?
I didn't play with that band - now that must have been around 1928, '27 or '28. I didn't join the band until '31 and all this time I was traveling and on one-nighters and everything with them.
What else did they have besides a bus?
They didn't have a bus. We had a fleet of cars. The boys had bought the instrumental truck that carried the instruments.
Once or twice. I'd drive John's car, the Chevrolet.
